summary: Patriot Acquisition Corp. filed an 8-K to report completion of its initial public offering and partial exercise of the underwriter's over-allotment option. On May 18, 2026, it consummated the IPO of 16,000,000 units at $10.00/unit ($160M gross proceeds), each unit consisting of one Class A ordinary share and one-half of one redeemable warrant. On May 21, 2026, Keefe, Bruyette and Woods partially exercised the over-allotment option for an additional 1,500,000 units ($15M gross proceeds). Simultaneously, the company privately sold 5,200,000 private placement warrants at $1.00/warrant. This is a routine capital formation event, not a special situation.
